title: Provision of Distributed Antenna System for Haymarket
description: The NTA is seeking tender responses from Service Providers who have proven skills, knowledge and experience to install a Distributed Antenna System (DAS) for its Haymarket office located at Haymarket House, Smithfield, Dublin 7. The DAS system installed must be able to support and facilitate signal re-broadcasting of mobile network operators throughout the building. The Service Provider will provide the following services (the “Services”). i. The design and installation of a DAS solution suitable for the NTAs mobile requirements on site in Smithfield, capable of delivery of the below minimum reception standards: o 800 MHz band o 900 MHz band (3G – Voice – will be live on the system) o 1800 MHz band (4G – Data – will be live on this system) o 2100 MHz band (3G – Voice - will be live on this system) o 2600 MHz band ii. Presenting design criteria to secure approval for technical sign-off from the MNOs and NTA prior to installation. The Service Provider will be responsible for ensuring that all services are completed in line with building fit out schedule, currently planned for Q2 2024. This is an indicative timeline. The DAS will be installed to ensure seamless mobile phone connectivity throughout the entire building. The system must be fully compliant with the latest JOTS and MIPS. title: Germany – Pharmaceutical products – Abschluss einer nicht-exklusiven Rabattvereinbarung nach § 130a Abs. 8 SGB V zum Wirkstoff Diclofenac (ausschließlich GEL 25 g), ATC D11AX18 für die Zeit 01.04.2025 - 31.03.2027
description: § 130a Absatz 8 SGB V ermöglicht den Krankenkassen und pharmazeutischen Unternehmen, Rahmenrabattverträge über die zu Lasten der gesetzlichen Krankenkassen abzugebenden Arzneimittel zuschließen. In Hinblick auf die dafür einschlägigen gesetzlichen Vorschriften zur Vergabe öffentlicher Aufträge, findet ein regelmäßiger Prozess wirkstoffbezogener, förmlicher Vergabeverfahren nach den Regularien des 4. Teils des GWB durch die DAK-Gesundheit statt. Für vom Bieter näher in der Anlage 2 zum Vertrag zu benennende Arzneimittel zu dem o. g. Wirkstoff, Diclofenac (ausschließlich GEL 25 g), ATC D11AX18, beabsichtigt die DAK-Gesundheit, bis zum Inkrafttreten neuer Arzneimittelrabattverträge mit möglichst allen interessierten pharmazeutischen Unternehmen Arzneimittelrabattverträge abzuschließen. Ein Rabattvertrag i.R.d. Zulassungsmodells zu dem o. g. Wirkstoff tritt erstmals am 01.04.2025 in Kraft und endet am 31.03.2027. Er endet unabhängig davon automatisch mit Inkrafttreten des Exklusivvertrages.

title: T711-901SD DYNAMIC LOCATION AND TIME-WINDOW UNCERTAINTIES DURING UNCONTROLLED RE-ENTRY (EXPRO+)
description: Historical data associated with the uncontrolled re-entry of satellite and rocket bodies yielded that, as a rule of thumb, the driving uncertainty of where these events take place can be linked to 20% of the remaining orbital lifetime and that there is an underlying 50% uncertainty on the drag experienced between 80 and 200 km. These uncertainties are mostly empirical and neglect any relationwith the actual object shape and resulting drag, and feature as input to design for demise envelope condition when it comes to establishing fragmentation altitude and as such influence casualty risk reduction developments. Recently satellites have started to collect data and continue operation from 200km down to re-entry, allowing the investigation of said data from Very Low Earth Orbit (VLEO)missions and the re-entry predictions of re-entry experiments to define a more realistic time windows for the re-entry epochs and dynamically accounting for (at least) the solar activity indexes. Linked to this initial uncertainty is the historical data on re-entry locations and debris found on-ground, to verify the accuracy of the on-ground impact probability for uncontrolled re-entry and the empirical correcting factors based on equatorial bulge and solar activity index. The activity aims to reduce the margins on uncertainties associated with initial break-ups during atmospheric destructive re-entry by recalibrating on data gathered from VLEO missions and re-entry experiments.

title: Germany – Architectural, construction, engineering and inspection services – Forensik - Köln-Merheim, Generalplanerleistung
description: Am Standort Köln Merheim beabsichtigt der Landschaftsverband Rheinland (LVR) einen Neubau für die Forensik II "nebenan" erstellen zu lassen und die bisherige forensische Nutzung in der weiter bestehenden LVR-Klinik (dort künftig dann andere Nutzung) ganz aufzugeben. Hintergrund ist, dass das derzeit genutzte Gebäude den aktuellen baulichen und funktionalen Anforderungen nicht mehr entspricht und dauerhaft überbelegt ist. Das derzeit forensisch genutzte Gebäude (Haus "O") der LVR-Klinik liegt entfernt vom geplanten Neubauprojekt und wird nicht in die Neubauplanung einbezogen. Vorgesehen ist die Realisierung einer forensisch psychiatrischen Klinik durch einen Neubau in konventioneller Bauweise unter Einbeziehung eines bestehenden Gebäudes (bisher "Haus 40"), das erhalten und gegebenenfalls als Forensische Ambulanz weitergenutzt werden soll. Das Vorhaben umfasst sowohl eine quantitative Erweiterung der Platzzahl und die Anpassung der Raumgrößen als auch eine qualitative und konzeptionelle Weiterentwicklung der forensischen Versorgung. Die Generalplanerleistung für das Vorhaben Forensik Köln-Merheim umfasst im Wesentlichen folgende Leistungsbilder: - Objektplanung Gebäude und Innenräume HOAI Teil 3 Abschnitt 1 - Fachplanung Freianlagen HOAI Teil 3 Abschnitt 2 - Fachplanung Ingenieurbauwerke HOAI Teil 3 Abschnitt 3 - Fachplanung Verkehrsanlagen HOAI Teil 4 Abschnitt 4 - Fachplanung Tragwerk HOAI Teil 4 Abschnitt 1 - Fachplanung Technische Ausrüstung Anlagengruppen 1-8 HOAI Teil 5 Abschnitt 5 - Beratungsleistungen gemäß Anlage 1 zu § 3 Abs. 1 HOAI: Bauphysik (Schall- und Wärmeschutz, Raumakustik) und geotechnische Beratungsleistung - Fachplanung Brandschutz Auf Grundlage der Ergebnisse der Vorplanung wird der Auftraggeber die Umsetzbarkeit (Finanzierung/Genehmigungsfähigkeit) des Vorhabens abschließend prüfen. Bei Fortsetzung des Projektes ist beabsichtigt die Leistungsphasen 3 ff als zweite Auftragsstufe abzurufen.

title: AI for Public Good Lot 1 (Health: Innovative AI-based cancer imaging solutions for breast and prostate diagnosis) and Lot 2 (Energy: Innovative AI-based solutions for electric grid optimization)
description:
The European Commission is committed to tapping into the potential of Artificial Intelligence (AI) to collaboratively and complementarily drive research to address global challenges. 
DG CONNECT is the European Commission’s Directorate General responsible for digital policies. Through its Directorate A “Artificial Intelligence Office”, it is tasked to implement the AI Act and promote the development and use of trustworthy AI. Additionally, it focuses on creating solutions for societal good, while also facilitating the implementation of international AI agreements to contribute to a global approach to AI. 
The purpose of this call for tenders is to develop and test AI-powered solutions for the benefit of the EU as well as wider communities and third countries. The call has two lots, on AI for Cancer imaging (LOT1) and on AI for Electric grid optimisation (LOT2).
LOT 1 will explore and demonstrate how AI-powered solutions applied to EU cancer imaging data can be further fine-tuned and applied in other locations and settings covering a large variety of populations, without transferring the underlying sensitive health data. It has two predefined use-cases, breast cancer and prostate cancer.
LOT2 will support the European Commission in exploring and demonstrating the application of AI- powered solutions to effectively tackle challenges within energy systems, specifically focusing on the seamless integration of renewable energy sources (RES) capacity across diverse energy system levels.
buyer: European Commission, DG CNECT - Communications Networks, Content and Technology

title: 81306308-Soutien à une gestion circulaire de l'eau urbaine au Maroc
description: The project "Circular economy in urban water management" is working in Morocco with the MATNUHPV (Ministry of Town and Country Planning, Housing and Urban Policy) at national level and in the cities of Marrakech and Tangier to integrate circular water management and climate-resilient water management into urban planning and development. This call for tender is intended to support the project in the following areas: - Analysis of urban vulnerability/resilience and modelling of scenarios Firstly, the service provider is tasked to analyse the vulnerability and resilience of the two cities (Marrakech and Tangier) in relation to climate change. This will make it possible to: i) qualitatively assess the vulnerability of the two cities to the risks associated with climate change by studying their exposure, sensitivity, and capacity to adapt, and ii) rank the level of vulnerability associated with the various impacts, in relation to the scale of the consequences and the probability of occurrence of these impacts. Subsequently, the service provider shall model two scenarios, one (1) for the city of Marrakech and one (1) for the city of Tangier, taking into account the "Referentiel" (national guidelines about circular water management) and the "cross diagnosis of urban water management". These two national services will be contracted in Morocco beforehand. - Application of the "Referentiel" about circular water management in two urban planning documents, one in Marrakech, one in Tangier. The aim of this phase is to integrate the principles of the circular water economy and ensure that the Framework is applied in an urban planning document currently being drawn up for the two cities, in order to promote sustainable management of water resources and ensure urban resilience in the face of water-related challenges. The aim is to ensure that the Framework for integrating the circular water economy is anchored in the local realities of the two Moroccan cities, promoting successful and sustainable implementation and drawing lessons on potential bottlenecks and shortcomings in its application - Development of an urban vision for circular water management, which is adopted by the city councils and based on the developed guidelines about circular water management as well as national and local rules and regulations. The objective of this part is to work in a participatory, inclusive and gender-sensitive process with the two cities of Marrakech and Tangier on the development of an urban/communal Vision for a future circular water economy in the two cities which is than translated into a concrete action plan. - Development of two "bankable" projects, one for each of the two cities, in the field of the circular economy of urban water, ready to be submitted to financial intermediaries. The selected projects derive from the city action plan (see above). Project preparation to "bankability" must be in line with IFIs (international financing institutions) financing requirements. - Integration of climate-sensitive and water-relevant data into the Ministry's Geoportal (GIS).The aim of this work package is to provide technical support to the Department of Urban Planning and to integrate the climate and water relevant GIS data of the two cities (Tangiers and Marrakesh) into the Ministry's Géoportail. Furthermore the technical basis (architecture, structures and data components) for the integration of an additional layer (climate and water relevant data) in the existing GIS system of the ministry are to be developed. - Capacity-development for relevant actors in the field of urban circular water management. The aim of this work package is to build the institutional and technical capacities of national partners, urban development agencies, local authorities, local water service providers and civil society to develop and integrate a circular water economy that is resilient to climate change into urban planning and development. It is intended to have two fulltime consultants, one for each city, and several expert-pools for water, digitalization/IT, project preparation and capacity development. One of the full-time experts will be the contractor's team leader. The service is planned to last for 18 months. Extension possible under certain circumstances.
